note: Fixed before any Tier 0 run executes, per preregistration.md §9. Not changed after seeing results.

base_expert_selection.method: 1-epoch screening pass over all 4 base experts on FB15K-237, capped eval, pick highest valid MRR

A3_definition: best_base + path_reasoner(budgeted_bfs) + seionic_scalar (no projection, no rank controller, no curricula, no learned selector, no E8 -- those are Fase 6-9 components already unit-tested separately, not benchmarked at dataset scale in Tier 0)

A3_deviation_subsample.reason: A live timing probe (full WN18RR, batch_size=256, A3 config, 1 epoch) ran 8+ minutes without completing before being stopped. Logged as a preregistration deviation BEFORE any A3 result was generated -- see preregistration.md §11.

honesty_statement: This is a 2-seed screening pass on two datasets: A0 at full dataset scale, A3 on a 5,000-triple subsample (both deviations logged BEFORE results were seen). It is NOT a Gate 12 confirmatory result (needs 5 seeds, full dataset scale, full epoch budget, and the full 13-point ablation ladder with statistical testing per preregistration.md §5/§8). Every artifact and report referencing these runs must say SCREENING (reduced), never CONFIRMATORY.
